summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by International General Insurance Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting, Information Circular, and proxy materials. The meeting covers routine items: election of a Class III director, reappointment of Ernst & Young as auditor, and receipt of audited financial statements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is announced. The filing is a routine current report on Schedule 13e-3 events; thus, it does not constitute a special situation.
